reply.text: Sounds like the heat got the better of you. If you felt dizzy, faint, short of breath, or unwell, that's one for a doctor, not a coach, so get it checked if it's more than a rough few minutes. On the training side, keep the sauna short and cool down before you go back in, and drink water before and after. Next time, start at a lower temperature and build up. What were you training today?
